description: Planet-in-house entries from Vol II, paraphrased. status 'done' rows have paraphrased conditions and remedies; 'todo' rows only carry the page pointer of the book entry. Condition 'when' is a list of machine clauses (all must hold); null means qualitative only. Clause kinds: in {planets any-of, houses any-of}, together [a,b], empty [house], alone.

conditions.effect: Pious ruler type when Sun sits in houses 1, 5 or 11; fortune rises after marriage if H7 is empty.
Venus in H7 shortens the father's life and weakens the wife's health.
Saturn in H8: spouses are lost one after another.
Mars in H5: sons are lost one after another.
Moon in H2 with Saturn in H11 increases wealth.
Mercury and Venus together give lifelong prosperity.
Mars in H1 makes one miserable.
Moon in H12 makes one miserable.
Moon in H6 becomes exalted.
Moon in H8 damages the Sun.
If H8 is empty, the Sun and H2 matters turn out well.
Sun and Jupiter do not give their separate results; Jupiter follows the Sun.
Earning by service is favourable; accepting donations destroys.

rows.theme: Wealth through own effort; character decides fortune.

conditions.effect: Wealth stays intact even if the parents are poor.
Harmful Mars negative or a weak Venus or Mercury gives poor outcomes.
A malefic Mercury hurts Ketu matters and maternal uncles.
Malefic Moon brings thefts and losses in daytime.

rows.theme: Toils and saves for others; hidden wealth for children.

conditions.effect: Moon in H4 or H5 gives prosperity.
Mercury in H10 brings riches.
Saturn in H7: poor eyesight and poverty.
Rahu in H1 pollutes the Sun.
Saturn in H1 pollutes the Sun.
Jupiter or Mars in H10 behave like thieves; thefts reduce savings.

remedies.text: Give food or alms to ten blind persons to clear the poison between H5 and H10.
Remedy the Moon first; once the Moon is favourable, add the remedy of Saturn. Red coral items help.

conditions.effect: Jupiter in H10: the native loses wives.
Saturn in H3: the native loses sons.
Moon in H4 supports the Sun here.
Birth of a son brings prosperity; an east-facing kitchen helps; comfortable old age.

rows.theme: Burnt by fire but never short of livelihood; contented.

conditions.effect: Never short of a livelihood and not childless, provided he does not break the rear wall or turn obstinate.
Saturn in H12: the wife dies.
If H2 is empty, the father dies.
Mars in H10 kills progeny.
Mercury in H12 destroys standing with authority.
Rahu in H1 eclipses fortune.
Saturn in H1 eclipses fortune.
Ketu in H1 or H7 is benefic.
Harm around the Sun's ages 11 and 22 if the Moon is malefic.

remedies.text: During evil effects on progeny, give jaggery to a monkey, or do the remedy of Mercury.

rows.theme: Small family; a king without a crown who toils for prosperity.

conditions.effect: An empty H1 leaves H7 dormant.
Venus joining the Sun sends him philandering outside; the wife must stay chaste or the family suffers.
Jupiter, Moon or Mars in H2 gives high office.
Jupiter, Venus and Rahu-Ketu-Saturn together destroy a separate Mercury.
Family life is destroyed and gold turns to dust.
Prosperity comes after Mercury's period; wealth and family comfort after age 34.

remedies.text: Keep a clean, sober outlook; act as a firm administrator and speak softly in business.
If Saturn is in H1 or afflicts the Sun, do the Moon remedy: after dinner extinguish the hearth fire with milk, leave it unlit till morning, do this 43 days, then drop the iron pan into running water.
Bury a few rectangular or square pieces of copper under the house floor, or start work after drinking sweet water.
Serve a black or hornless cow.
Offer a morsel of your meal to fire before eating.

rows.theme: A king with a saint's heart; a test of truthfulness.

conditions.effect: Sun here scares death, gives long life, royalty and prosperity.
With Mercury along, the Sun becomes like an evil planet.
Venus in houses 1 to 5 shortens life.
Liaisons ruin the native's progeny.
Polluted H1 makes one hide from the world.

remedies.text: Drink a little sweet water when leaving home.

rows.theme: Long life, large family; a source of strength after an eclipse.

conditions.effect: Mercury with or aspecting the Sun destroys the Sun's results.
Rahu in H3 or H5 makes one irreligious and comfort-seeking.
Self-respect and long prosperity if he refuses donations, silver or bribes.
Venus, Moon and houses 3 and 5 turn benefic.

remedies.text: Donating silver strengthens the benefic effects of the Sun.

rows.theme: Health, respect and wealth but a suspicious nature.

conditions.effect: A lone Sun here is generally malefic.
Moon in H2 takes the mother away around age 24.
Venus in H4 brings an early loss of the father (with a malefic Saturn).
Rahu, Ketu or Saturn in H6 shorten life and bring unhappiness.
Going bareheaded or wearing black or blue headgear brings misery.

remedies.text: Wear white or light pink headgear.

conditions.effect: Eating meat makes one issueless; giving up liquor and meat brings sons.
Mercury in H3 is harmful.
Moon in H8 is harmful.
Moon in H5 gives long age but costs progeny in H12.
Eating or accepting things of Saturn makes one childless.

remedies.text: Donate white vegetables such as radish.
Keep almonds at the bedside overnight and give them away in the morning.
If Mercury is malefic or Saturn items were eaten, give away a live goat.

rows.theme: A carefree king; comfortable sleep but burnt by fires lit by others.

conditions.effect: Rahu or Ketu in H1 brings service problems and loss of sleep.
A lone Sun in H12 brings sorrow, eye trouble and mental strain.
Moon in H6 harms the Sun here.
Devotion brings progeny and comfort; forgiveness in adversity brings victory.
Gain is better from business than from government service.
